cells.value: Cabinets & Front panels of the various units of the system do not show any imperfections, abrasions, shock damages and units are correctly mounted.
No physical damages to electrical parts.
All the LRUs are placed in the racks correctly in the respective slots and connections are given properly.
All units and racks are secured properly.
Fixing and locking nuts/ screws are tightened.
All fuses are of correct rating and fuse setting matches with input power supply.
Checks of front panel controls (a) Switches (b) Power ON LEDs.
All switches and controls operate freely.
Check availability of stabilized power supply to the system.
Select "Remote" & "Start" from "Main Menu" of Radio set for Bite check.
Check complete Bite test status in "Admin/BITE" from RCU i.e. HFIU, Radio, Modem, Power Amplifier, ATU and Power Supply Unit.
Check voice test using AM mode on 3,16 and 26 MHz
Check voice test in SSB Mode:
Data checks using Narrow band on 3 MHz :
Data checks using Wide Band on 24 MHz
Check Remote selection of Modes of operation.(USB, LSB, ISB, CW and FSK)
Check Remote setting of Frequencies (12, 16 and 17 MHz).
Check Remote setting of Power output.(10W, 100W, 250W, 500W and 1KW).
